full_judgment: 4. The defendant Nos.7-19 contested the suit by another joint written statement, contending inter alia, that Sandhya Rani settled .06 acre of land from Plot No.1555 to Nuta Shah. Accordingly, R.S. Record of right was prepared in this name in Khatian No.476. The plaintiffs purchased .06 acre of land by registered kabala dated 29.11.1973 from Yeasin and Siddique Ali. The plaintiffs also got settlement of 2.40 acres of land from Subarna Lata and Sandhya Rani by a registered kabuliyat dated 04.02.1956. After transfer of so,me lands, the plaintiffs have been possessing 1.84 acres of land. Their names were recorded in S.A. Khatian No.48 I. Since the name of Rohini was erroneously recorded in S.A. Khatian No.480 in respect of .15 acre of land, the plaintiffs got declaration of their title in respect of the said land in Other Suit No.492 of 1969 in the Court of Munsif, Gaibandha and accordingly, they mutated their names in the Khatian. Furkuni and Kanak Prova visited Goya Dham. Furkuni died in 1966. The plaintiffs are not the reversioners of Raj Kanta. Guno Mohin Das and Ramanatida Das left Bangladesh for India. The shit should be dismissed.
